7. A session with a request every 10 minutes is refused 8 hours after its
   sign-in; a session signed out is refused at its next request, also within
   its 30 minutes.
   Shows A13-1. [witness: verification:registry_a13_eight_hours_and_sign_out_refused]
statements: owner_session s valid at t <=> t < s.began + 8h and   -- A13-1

verdicts.why: The selected test keeps the session active with requests every 10 minutes, verifies service immediately before the eight-hour boundary, and verifies refusal exactly at eight hours. It also signs out a session and verifies that its next request one minute later is refused, while another session remains usable.
